title: Import: discover Maven, Gradle, and explicit Java project roots
objective: Locate project roots and declared output layouts without executing Maven, Gradle, wrappers, or project code.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit roots win and ancestor discovery has bounded deterministic precedence.
Maven and Gradle metadata is inspected conservatively without running builds.
Ambiguous multi-project layouts produce diagnostics rather than guessed roots.
non_goals: Do not weaken protected contracts, workflow configuration, or unrelated capabilities.
Do not load or execute target classes, builds, plugins, annotation processors, or code.
Do not copy implementation code from the upstream ArchUnit project.
Do not add dependencies or change Maven configuration.
